text:
Sophia: Heads up — OrionCloud just told us EU rack lead times slipped from ~6w to ~10w. This impacts the Dedicated capacity we promised for the marketplace joint launch in Nov. Need quick triage. :eyes:
Mateo: Ugh. Which reservations are affected? Any specific resv IDs?
Sophia: Affected bucket: EU-Q3-dedicated and EU-marketplace-promo. Example resv id: `RESV-87321` and `RESV-87322`. Partner note attached in email but TL;DR: freight backlog + customs paperwork delay.
Liam: I pulled the reservations. Quick dump:
```
RESV-87321: 8x A100 racks, ETA old 2024-11-03 -> new 2025-01-08
RESV-87322: 4x A10G racks, ETA old 2024-11-10 -> new 2025-01-15
```
We have a small buffer in non-prod EU pool (RESV-90011) but contracts block moving marketplace-dedicated SKUs w/o partner ok.
Rachel: Product here — the joint launch announcement is scheduled for 11/15 in the marketplace. If we can't guarantee capacity within SLOs, we should either delay or publish with a scaled offering. What's the earliest we can promise degraded capacity? :thinking_face:
Mateo: Options I see:
- Ask Orion for expedited manifest (air freight) and pay uplift
- Reassign buffer racks from pilot customers (requires partner/legal signoff)
- Offer a smaller GA footprint on launch (e.g., fewer zones / smaller concurrency)
Liam: Technical constraints: the GA model variants for marketplace require quantized runtime on A100s. We could temporarily serve lower concurrency from US pools via cross-region routing, but latency will be worse for EU customers. Batching + prefix cache might hide some perf issues though.
Sophia: I'm on a call with our Orion rep at 14:30. I'll push for expedited shipping or split shipments to get partial capacity by mid-Nov. Also asking for written confirmation we can reallocate 2 racks if we pay expedite fee.
Ops-bot: calendar: "Orion capacity crisis — triage call" created for 2024-10-09 14:30 UTC. Invitees: sophia, mateo, liam, rachel.
Mateo: If Orion won't budge, we should prepare a marketplace distillation plan: show customers a smaller SKU set + transparent ETA. I can draft language for the marketplace listing.
Rachel: Agree. Draft a fallback announcement that says "staged availability" and lists expected zones + ETA. Avoid saying "delay" if we can at all help it.
Liam: Ops action item: I'll run an availability check script and a reassign dry-run. Command I'll run:
```
./scripts/resv-reassign --dry-run --from RESV-90011 --to RESV-87321
```
Will post results in this thread in ~30m.
Sophia: Partnership action item: I'll push Orion for split shipments + expedited manifest and ask legal for a temporary amendment allowing reassign. ETA EOD today. Tagging @mateo for communications and @liam for ops.
Mateo: I'll prepare the scaled SKU copy + decision matrix (delay vs scaled launch). If we have a definitive answer by Friday 17:00 UTC we can decide.
Liam: Dry-run done: reassign blocked by enterprise lock on RESV-87321 (contract clause 4.2). If we get a signed amendment, reassign works. Posting logs: `ERR_LOCKED_CONTRACT clause 4.2`.
Rachel: Ok — plan: 1) Partnerships (Sophia) to get partner amendment or expedited shipping by EOD. 2) Ops (Liam) to be ready to reassign on green. 3) Product (Rachel/Mateo) to finalize scaled-marketplace copy by Thursday. 4) If no resolution by Fri 17:00 UTC, postpone the public announcement and run a soft preview for pilot customers only.
Sophia: On it. I'll update after the 14:30 call. :thumbsup:
Mateo: Thanks — will draft comms and share in #marketing as well.
Ops-bot: Note: added follow-up reminder for 2024-10-11 17:00 UTC.
